sentences.en: My brother hides his porn magazines under his mattress.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥把色情杂志藏在他的床垫下面。

sentences.en: Do you really hide your money under the mattress?
sentences.zh: 你真的会把钱藏在床垫下面吗？

sentences.en: The mattress was too soft for me to sleep on comfortably.
sentences.zh: 这张床垫太软了，让我睡不舒服。

senses.zh: 床垫,褥垫,空气垫,建沉排
